tagline: A smart bandage: engineered probiotics inside electrospun alginate nanofibers that release an anti-fibrotic peptide only where a wound is scarring badly.
summary: Every scar treatment on the market today starts after the scar has formed — silicone sheeting, intralesional steroid, laser and grafts are all passive or reactive, and none addresses fibrosis biology during the critical healing window. Klothos intervenes during healing instead: engineered bacteria secrete 810A, a 12-amino-acid peptide that binds the exposed C-terminal domain of CTGF (CCN2) and blocks fibroblast-to-myofibroblast activation, and expression is held behind a two-input AND gate built from the Pseudomonas syringae hrpR/hrpS/hrpL system so the peptide is only made when reactive oxygen species (via TrxC) and hypoxia (via Pfnr) are both present — the signature of unchecked remodelling. The bacteria are encapsulated in an alginate/PEO nanofiber matrix spun on a coaxial electrospinner the team designed and built themselves, because commercial instruments cost far more than an undergraduate team can reach. It won Best Hardware and Best Presentation on the strength of that open, flat-packable, interlock-protected electrospinner plus a modular 3D-printed coaxial spinneret adapter, and Best Fashion & Cosmetics on a project that is unusually complete end to end: 20-plus risk-rated commercialisation analysis, a six-phase FDA path, and a human practices programme built around people who actually live with scars.

dry.frameworks: Cornell's modelling splits cleanly into wet lab and product development. On the biology side: a production-degradation ODE (dF/dt = alpha*X - delta_F*F) for SUMO-His-810A accumulation against biomass; a Hill function for Tet and future inducible promoter activity; Michaelis-Menten kinetics for SUMO protease cleavage to recover active peptide; an ELISA-based Hill-Langmuir binding isotherm for 810A against CTGF/C, fixed at n=1 because there is a single site, with an explicit note that a fitted n far from 1 would indicate error rather than cooperativity; and a quadratic ligand-depletion model for the regime where accessible CTGF and peptide concentrations are comparable and the ordinary Langmuir assumption breaks. Downstream of binding they built a reduced-order dynamic systems model of fibroblast state transition, parameterised from a protein interaction network assembled in STRING v12.5 — filtered on the Scarring Human Phenotype Ontology term HP:0100699, recovering 48 weighted edges, merged with CCN2's 20 nearest first-degree and 10 nearest second-degree neighbours, surfacing SMAD3, FN1 and TGFB2 as major nodes. Those nodes and weights were then run in Netflux as a logic-based ODE network (normalised node activity with a time constant, modified Hill activation and inhibition functions) using COL1A1 accumulation as the proxy for extracellular matrix hardening, and the simulation tracks the downstream TGF-beta inhibition reported in Xiao et al. 2020. Wound environment is modelled explicitly: ROS as a transient peak function calibrated against Carney et al. 2019 time-series qRT-PCR of SOD1, MGST1 and PRDX6 in hypertrophic scars, oxygen as an exponential recovery function, each feeding a Hill-function promoter. AlphaFold was used to render 810A and the CTGF/C-810A-6xHis complex. On the hardware side: a semi-empirical predictor of shell-solution viscosity (polymer overlap and entanglement statistics via Mark-Houwink), conductivity (mobile ion contribution) and surface tension (surfactant adsorption with a CMC/CAC plateau), the Fridrikh scaling law for terminal jet radius from flow rate, jet current and surface tension, plus continuity-based flow rate and stepper-motor plunger speed models.
dry.dataviz: The standout is the Unified Readiness Classifier, which collapses three separate property predictions into a single green/yellow/red call on whether a formulation should go to the electrospinner at all — green means proceed to voltage-window testing, yellow allows one short trial or minor reformulation, red means reformulate first. It is rendered as a spinning-viability contour map over sodium alginate and PEO weight percentages produced by Monte Carlo sampling against literature results, so a reader can see the spinnable region rather than read a table of numbers. The alginate molecular-weight analysis is similarly well-framed: one plot puts viscosity on the left axis spanning more than four orders of magnitude while conductivity and surface tension on the right axis stay flat, which makes the whole argument visible at a glance — conductivity caps how much alginate you can dissolve, molecular weight decides whether that limit is reachable, and the optimum is interior rather than monotonic. The STRING network is shown as a force-directed layout and the Netflux run as normalised activity curves for CTGF, TGFB1, FN1, COL1A1, SMAD2 and SMAD3 together. The wiki itself is a scroll-driven 3D island journey ('scroll to travel, click an island to explore') with an interactive AND-gate widget letting the reader switch each input signal on and off, and a WebGL model of the electrospinner.
dry.datascience: The classifier is the clearest case of turning data into a predictive tool: rather than measuring solutions after purchase, Cornell predicts viscosity, conductivity and surface tension from formulation inputs (alginate concentration, PEO concentration and molecular weight, surfactant type and concentration, salt or buffer content, temperature) and uses the prediction to avoid spinning runs that cannot work. They name candidate implementations — logistic regression, random forest, or Gaussian process classification, favouring the Gaussian process on a small dataset because it returns uncertainty — and define a two-level validation plan: property-level (mean absolute error for viscosity, percent error for conductivity, absolute error in mN/m for surface tension against held-out measured formulations) and outcome-level (whether predicted-green formulations actually produce stable shell-only fibres, judged on Taylor cone formation, current stability, bead formation, dry deposition and fibre diameter distribution). They say outright that the classifier matters more than exact numerical accuracy, and that literature Mark-Houwink, CMC and adsorption constants are starting estimates to be recalibrated against the team's own measurements. Fibre morphology was quantified by image analysis: tortuosity as the ratio of fibre contour length to end-to-end distance, with a >1.10 threshold defining 'curly', giving 8% curly and 92% straight. Failure diagnosis was also model-driven — droplet breakup was traced to insufficient PEO chain entanglement at 100 kDa, leading them to raise PEO from 1.5% to 2% and cut back PS80 surfactant.
dry.software: No standalone software release; the released artefact is the hardware. The electrospinner is published openly as a bill of materials, CAD files, circuit diagrams, assembly documentation, an operation manual and a dedicated safety manual, designed to be disassembled and flat-packed for transport by teams in shared or temporary workspaces. Control is an ESP32 DevKitC microcontroller driving an AHV24V30KVR5MAW high-voltage module (24 V in, up to 30 kV out) for digitised control in place of a potentiometer, with an access-door interlock and emergency stop that cut power and ground the high-voltage circuit. A separate contribution is the modular 3D-printed coaxial needle adapter, which keeps metal needle tips for conductivity while 3D-printing the structure, adaptable across needle gauges and core-shell flow configurations. They also publish a disulfide-bond-optimised SHuffle expression protocol (6xHis-SUMO fusion, SUMO as chaperone and clean cleavage handle) framed for reuse on other hard-to-express proteins such as insulin-like growth factors, antibody fragments and venom peptides, plus protocols for alginate preparation, crosslinking viability testing, escape testing, light microscopy ImageJ analysis and spectrographic bacterial settling.

good.publicEngagement: Cornell ran an unusually wide and genuinely iterative education programme. Plasmid Pals, their own educational game, was playtested with Big Brothers Big Sisters participants who then suggested how to make it more interactive. Plasmid bracelets plus an open-ended idea board asking visitors how they would use synthetic biology to change the world evolved into age-adapted versions for daycare, the Sciencenter and the State Fair — and when reading and spelling turned out to be barriers for roughly 20 preschoolers, the team switched to a cooking analogy (DNA as cookbook, RNA as copied recipe, protein as finished dish), writing up the lesson that activities must match developmental ability. A summer-camp session had about 80 students debate which scientific problems deserve funding using live polls, and a 30-minute lesson drew another 20-25 minutes of student-led questions about research careers and contributing without lab access. STEM Her Way was a four-session series in which high school girls learned synthetic biology and presented their own research proposals, rated 4.7/5 by 15 respondents across seven countries with every respondent recommending it. A shadowing programme drew more than 260 applications from the US and 17 countries for six high school scholars, later extended to five international students whose own project proposals the team helped assess for feasibility — a participant from Uzbekistan brought soil salinity as a community problem and the students developed Salt Guardians around it. They also ran a worldwide synthetic biology governance competition (regulatory pathways, biosafety and containment, access and equity, plus an open governance challenge), produced a narrative synthetic biology podcast, taught Lambert iGEM how to prepare stakeholder questions by sharing their own Human Practices deck and brainstorming guide, and swapped children's books with NUGEM — NUGEM translating Cornell's into Kazakh and Russian while Cornell translated NUGEM's into Mandarin, Spanish and French.
good.ihp: Several interviews changed the project rather than decorating it. The clearest is hardware: advised not to build their own high-voltage power supply (especially from microwave parts) because the electrical risk is serious, the team dropped the homemade supply entirely, consulted Cornell's Afridi Lab, and bought a commercial regulated unit while sourcing other parts through Digi-Key and Mouser to hold cost down — the advice was that boosting voltage is easy but a stable regulated DC output is the hard part. Dr Insoo Hyun reframed safety itself: he introduced weighing risks and benefits against existing alternatives rather than assuming absolute safety, and warned that familiarity with a microorganism from food use does not demonstrate safety in an open wound, also pressing them to choose experimental models that resemble real wound conditions rather than the most convenient ones. Dr Joseph Fins pushed on preclinical evidence and asked whether delivering the peptide directly, without living bacteria, would be safer and simpler — which the team now carries explicitly as a documented de-risking architecture, with the trade-off (a pre-loaded matrix gives a fixed dose and loses the AND-gated release) stated rather than hidden. Dr Andrew Leask's input on CCN2/CTGF signalling shaped the target rationale, and reviewer pressure to confirm H2O2 is still detectable at the wound stage they target led them to work on sensor sensitivity and add the hypoxia AND gate for specificity. Burn survivor and former burn nurse Amy Acton and Andrea at the Phoenix Society for Burn Survivors changed how the team talks: survivors need support long after wounds heal — financial help for compression garments and procedures, emotional support, connection with others — treatments are costly, uncomfortable and variable, so do not promise how much a treatment will reduce scarring. Roughly 20 older adults and visitors at open events taught them that a scar's size or appearance does not predict its personal impact, and that open conversation surfaced concerns their structured survey questions missed; they concluded existing scales describe the scar but not what the person would want improved. Alison Bateman-House at NYU identified composition and method-of-production as their strongest patent claims and walked them through the one-year US grace period and PCT economics, which fed directly into the commercialisation plan. A kelp-farming conversation moved the sustainability case from biodegradability to sourcing, noting that North American kelp farmers' binding constraint is finding buyers rather than growing kelp since wild-harvested seaweed is substantially cheaper — a point that complicates rather than flatters their own narrative.
good.realWorld: This is the most developed commercial package of the five. Target market is quantified: burn centres and academic hospitals in the American Northeast, where 2,255 medical institutions — 26 verified burn centres, 604 hospitals (31 with ACGME dermatology residencies) and 1,625 medical spas — serve an estimated 1.8 million addressable patients per year, or 2.2 patients per institution per day, with academic hospitals and verified burn centres targeted first as likeliest to trial new technology. The regulatory analysis identifies the real hazard: Klothos is a combination product (alginate nanofiber device plus engineered live bacteria), so FDA assigns a primary mode of action deciding whether CBER leads via IND/BLA or CDRH via 510(k)/PMA, and misclassification could force a restart costing an estimated 18-24 months and $500K-plus — hence a formal Pre-RFD consultation with the Office of Combination Products before committing development resources. They cite Azitra's engineered S. epidermidis with an open IND and FDA Fast Track as precedent that CBER will accept an IND for topical engineered bacteria. A six-phase plan runs from prototype and fibroblast assays, through an IND/IDE-enabling package with dermal safety, immunogenicity, biodistribution and microbial containment, to Phase I (with viable-organism monitoring because it is a live biotherapeutic) and a Phase II randomised controlled trial in surgical, burn, hypertrophic-scar-risk and revision-scar settings scored on POSAS, VSS and SCAR-Q. A freedom-to-operate analysis covers ten patents across four technology areas, with specific flags (the University of Manitoba colour-changing antibacterial nanofiber US20220047523A1 and NYCU's pending pH-sensitive electrospun bandage would need review before adding a pH indicator), plus PCT costs of roughly $17K to hold in 150 signatories and $20K per country thereafter. They map regulatory strategy across seven regions, including the MHRA consultation on modernising the GTMP definition (closed 22 June 2026) and Korea's MFDS review reforms cutting target timelines from about 420 to 295 days. Over 20 risks across technical, market, financial and regulatory categories are rated on severity, likelihood and detectability with mitigations and rendered as a heat map; a skill gap radar names what the 45-plus member team cannot yet do (pricing, physician adoption, launch strategy, clinical trial design) and how they would fill it. Reimbursement is treated honestly: novel combination products often lack an established billing code, so they model unit economics under both self-pay and reimbursed scenarios. The team won an ANSA grant and flagged Cornell's technology transfer office licensing terms as a Year 1 gating factor for any spinout.

gemsTakeaway: Build the cheap version of the instrument and publish it properly. Cornell's winning move was deciding that an electrospinner — normally a specialised commercial purchase — could be made from stock parts and 3D prints, then releasing the bill of materials, CAD, circuit diagrams, assembly guide, operation manual and a separate high-voltage safety manual with interlocks and an emergency stop designed in. For a school-based centre the paired lesson is the readiness classifier: predict a formulation's viscosity, conductivity and surface tension from its recipe, label it green/yellow/red, and spend scarce lab time only on green — a cheap model that saves expensive experiments is worth more than an elaborate one that does not change what you do next.
